name: Girgash
overview: Girgash is a male figure identified as a son of Canaan and a member of the Girgashite tribe. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or details about his life or character. He is recognized primarily for his genealogical placement among the descendants of Canaan.
namesAndTitles: The name Girgash appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:16. There is no specific meaning or divine origin attributed to the name in the biblical text, so it is simply recorded as the personal name of this individual.
familyAndRelationships: Girgash is identified as a son of Canaan according to Genesis 10:16, establishing his place within the lineage descending from Noah through Ham. Beyond this paternal relationship, Scripture does not provide further family details or connections.
scriptureSignificance: Girgash holds significance as part of the genealogical record that traces the origins of the Canaanite peoples. His inclusion in the biblical lineage underscores the fulfillment of God's sovereign plan in populating the earth after the flood. Though not elaborated upon, his mention contributes to the understanding of the nations descended from Canaan, who play a role in the broader biblical narrative.
